question: Who among the following was the Prime Minister when the Globalisation Policy as part of ‘New Economic Policy’ was introduced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Narasimha Rao**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• New economic policy-
 
 
• ​New economic policy was adopted in 1991 in India during a typical economic crisis.
 
• India was facing macroeconomic problems such as inflation, the inverse balance of payment, higher fiscal deficits, the oil crisis, inverse foreign exchange reverse etc during the 90s.
 
• To combat these macroeconomic problems India chose to reform the economy following the IMF and World Bank.
 
• Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation were three broad policies in the New economic policy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lawyer and politician PV Narasimha Rao led India as its ninth prime minister from 1991 to 1996.
 
• As the "Father of Indian Economic Reforms," he is frequently referred to.
 
• He oversaw significant economic development, a significant administration, and various domestic events that had an impact on India's national security.
 
• He was brought to Vangara, a village in the Bheemadevarpalle Mandal of the current Hanamkonda district in Telangana, where Pamulaparthi Ranga Rao and Rukminamma adopted him.
